context: Mei and Daichi celebrate their wedding anniversary.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: メイ、おめでとう、結婚記念日。
lines.style: Warm, generous opening with Kansai-region lilt. Loud enough to carry genuine affection without performance. Slight emphasis on her name—the kind of attention that says she's been on his mind all day.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Soft, genuine gratitude. Not effusive—she meets his warmth with quiet sincerity. Slight pause after his name, intimate and grounded.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: これ、サプライズの、プレゼント。
lines.en: I brought you something. A surprise.
lines.style: Building excitement beneath the surface. Kansai warmth in the vowels. Slight pride threading through—he's been holding this moment. Pacing quickens just barely as he offers it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: What is it? Can I open it?
lines.style: Curiosity and anticipation bright in her voice. No hesitation—trust and eagerness layered together. The question rises slightly at the end, inviting him in.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Soft permission wrapped in warmth. Kansai lilt gentle but present. He's waiting for this moment—you can hear him holding his breath slightly, letting her have the discovery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: A ring… I'm going to cry. I really am.
lines.style: Breath catches on the first word. Voice wavers with genuine overwhelm—not performed, but real tears threatening. Second phrase quieter, almost disbelieving. Trailing off into emotion rather than words.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Three years. I'm really grateful. For you.
lines.style: Serious now, underneath the Kansai warmth. Each phrase deliberate, like he's been practicing but the sincerity overrides any rehearsal. Slight deepening on the final words—weight of meaning.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Our whole family got to be happy. Because of this.
lines.style: Wonder in her voice—soft realization. Slow, thoughtful pacing. Not celebrating herself, but witnessing something larger. Quiet philosophical tone, almost in awe of how it all turned out.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ひかりも、すくすく育って。
lines.en: And Hikari's thriving. Growing so well.
lines.style: Proud and observant warmth. Kansai lilt on 'thriving.' He's watching their daughter grow and can't help but let the pleasure show. Light, affectionate tone—this is an easy happiness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 思い出、これからも、たくさん、作る。
lines.en: We'll make so many more memories. From now on.
lines.style: Forward-looking, hopeful. Her voice settles into gentle certainty. Not rushing—each phrase lands softly, like she's making a private promise. Slight emphasis on 'from now on,' opening into the future.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 一緒に、ずっと、生きていこう。
lines.style: Quiet intensity beneath Kansai warmth. Not a question—a commitment stated simply. Slow delivery, each word weighted. The 'always' trails slightly, echoing the promise into the room.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Yes. Always. You're the most precious person to me.
lines.style: Absolute conviction. No hesitation, no performance—just truth. Her voice deepens slightly on 'precious,' intimate and direct. The final phrase is both declaration and vow.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Kansai warmth full and unhurried. Not rushed—he's letting each word breathe. Closing warmth in his delivery, like he's said it a hundred times and means it fresh each time. Soft, deep sincerity.
